Text

Enhance

Sharpen off · Grayscale off · Square corners

0 = square, 100 = maximum (half of the shorter side: a pill, or a circle for a square image). Applied last, so it clips the watermark too.

Watermark position

Anchored bottom-right. Traverse in px: +X right, -X left, +Y down, -Y up.

Output

Resize keeps the aspect ratio when only one side is set. Rotation is applied before resizing.

Rotation does not apply to a collage; sharpen, grayscale, watermark, rounded corners, export and Android all work on the finished collage. Without a Margin of your own, the watermark is centred in the gutter band when it fits there. Tick "Show guides" to see numbered cell outlines.
